summary: Master the ISWM framework to develop a Solid Waste Management Plan. Learn waste characterization, logistics, and financial modeling. Enroll today.
lede: Solid waste management planning gives municipal teams a structured way to map waste flows and plan collection, recovery and disposal. For waste operations managers, urban planners, public works engineers and environmental professionals, the course focuses on developing that plan through waste characterization, route optimization and financial modeling, with additional work on material recovery, landfill capacity, policy and stakeholder engagement.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level course is tailored for professionals responsible for the strategic and operational aspects of urban sanitation and environmental health.
audience: Regulatory Affairs Specialists focused on Extended Producer
modules: Foundations of Integrated Solid Waste Management
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in municipal operations, environmental management, or urban planning. Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling exercises is required.
